<js>
const hz = "的一是了我不人在他有这个上们来到时大地为子中你说生国年着就那和要她出也得里后自以会家可下而过天去能对小多然于心学么之都好看起发当没成只如事把还用第样道想作种开美乳阴液茎欲呻肉交性胸私穴淫臀舔射脱裸骚唇";
const decode = s => String(s).replace(/[\ue800-\ue863]/gi, m => hz[m.charCodeAt(0) - 0xe800] ?? m);
const origin = (baseUrl.match(/^https?:\/\/[^\/]+/) || [""])[0];
const pageText = h => {
  const doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(h, baseUrl);
  let els = doc.select("#TextContent p");
  if (els.size() === 0) els = doc.select("#TextContent");
  const arr = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < els.size(); i++) {
    const t = String(els.get(i).text()).trim();
    if (t) arr.push(t);
  }
  return arr.join("\n");
};
let html = String(result);
let out = pageText(html);
let guard = 0;
while (guard++ < 50) {
  const m = html.match(/var\s+url_next\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/);
  if (!m) break;
  let nu = m[1];
  const cid = html.match(/cid="(\d+)"/);
  if (!cid || nu.indexOf(cid[1] + "_") === -1) break;
  if (!/^https?:/i.test(nu)) nu = origin + (nu.charAt(0) === "/" ? "" : "/") + nu;
  html = String(java.ajax(nu));
  const t = pageText(html);
  if (!t) break;
  out += t;
}
decode(out);
</js>
